## t2i 无审查·超分(1109 建,派生自 t2i-皮肤-超分)
结构=皮肤件组合件原样:④PrunaAI 6步 + 全局磨皮LoRA(7201/7202) + Gem 磨皮尾档(8100-8108)。
- **无审查双 LoRA(子图④臂,默认旁路,画布手动点亮)**:[7210] f23gg NSFW-Qwen2.1@1.0 + [7211] femaledVaginus L22-31@1.0;点亮即生效(旁路=运行时直通,无需重接线)
- [4] 空潜默认 **1024×1024**(用户令;按需改);提示词自填([400])
- 磨皮指令=全身修复句;直采已带全局磨皮;怼脸再走 [8108] 磨皮 10MP
- 依赖:ItsGemTools;NSFW 件双机 loras 在位(NSFW Qwen Lora.safetensors=f23gg HF 正源)

nodes.title: Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1 - One tile and the request
widgets_values: Restore this photo to professional quality. Remove all blur, noise, and compression artifacts from every visible surface — face, neck, shoulders, arms, hands, torso, legs, and feet. Recover sharp natural detail across all body skin: fine delicate pores, clean smooth texture, naturally radiant and healthy skin, individually resolved hair strands on the scalp and body, defined lip texture, crisp nail edges, and clear iris detail. Every patch of skin should look naturally smooth, finely grained, and true to life. Keep the exact same composition, framing, identity, pose, clothing, lighting, and every person unchanged.

widgets_values_named.prompt: Restore the photo: remove blur, noise and compression artifacts, recover sharp natural facial detail, clean skin texture, hair strands and lip texture, keeping the same composition, identity and people.

nodes.title: [7016] 子图说明·加速档位
widgets_values:
道劫·加速子图=四支路并行加速档+seed 单源+档位选择单点汇流(宿主面板=速度档位/seed;σ表已固化 viggle 支路 [7020] 九点官方表(1109 用户令下沉,面板不再外露);未选支路懒执行零加载)。
三支路:①档0 Turbo 官方8步 cfg1 负向无口=[7028 官方 avg_rank_178 LoRA×1.0 直挂,无 Fix 前挂(1017 勘误:旧文「前接 Fix×0.5」系 [7027] 计划未落地,子图无此节点)]→[7029 BasicGuider cfg1 纯正向]→[7031 SamplerCustomAdvanced]+[7030 ManualSigmas 官方σ表(9点=8步去噪+1);②档1 原生出图 cfg1(负向不参与采样)=[7026 Fix v2.0 官方域挂件(e-n-v-y 标定=全步数+cfg>1+真负向,LoraLoaderModelOnly×1.0)]→[7010] KSampler,负向仅档1(原生出图 cfg1)接线、负向不参与采样;③档2 viggle v0.3 官方9步满血=前7步 [7011 ViggleTurboLora 未合并]+[7012]段A,后2步 [7022]底模引导+[7024]段B(摘LoRA 底模收尾);[7021]按 step=7 切 [7020] 的9点动态shift σ表;蒸馏件 cfg恒1 负向无效。
[7014] seed 单源(viggle/Turbo 共用 [7017] 噪声,直出另线);三支路汇 [7015] 单点出 LATENT。
σ表面板贴表即换步数(9步=1.0, 0.975, 0.95, 0.925, 0.9, 0.875, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25 需配 [7021] step=7;6步单段=1.0, 0.9375, 0.875, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25 且 [7021] step=5)。

[7045] E混动·KSampler cfg4(1101 案B:SCA[7041/7042/7043]三件退役,scheduler/seed/正负向四合一入本件;cfg 1→4=fix 官方域生效前提,色重消退 S=0.331;seed=[7014] 新增扇出直连;[7017]/[7018] 仅 viggle/Turbo 臂消费(Q4 保留);σ表面板控 viggle 臂,与本件无关)

⑦臂入列档4·PrunaAI 6步(1108 用户令升默认,六车道终评22分与E臂肉眼无差/61.0s 快18%):底模→[7034]mikkoani@0.6→[7110]p_q_image_2.1_6_steps_v0.2×1.0(ViggleTurboLora 运行时旁路)→[7111]BasicGuider 关CFG+[7113]六步原表(1.0,0.925,0.85,0.625,0.375,0.125)动态shift→[7112]→本节点 latent_p;档3混动全保留可手选;「候列悬空」状态就此废止。
④PrunaAI 档输出=分辨率×2:[7121] LatentUpscaleBy(nearest-exact×2)插边界 latent→[7112];[4] 默认 1024²→出图 2048²(2K),长宽比跟随 [4](1109 用户令)。
